title: Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) Process and Policy

blocks.text: This RMA Process and Policy applies to all Zscaler Hardware.

To initiate the Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) process, submit a support ticket via the Zscaler Support Portal. Zscaler Support works with you to troubleshoot and diagnose issues remotely. If the issue cannot be resolved remotely or is determined to be a Hardware fault, Zscaler might decide to replace the Hardware.
Zscaler Support does the following to continue the RMA process:

blocks.item: Contact name, phone number, and email address
Product model, serial, and asset tag numbers
Creates an RMA number for tracking purposes.
Ships a replacement device to you.

blocks.text: A return shipping label is included with the replacement device in most cases. You must package the defective device and ship it to Zscaler within 30 calendar days of receiving the replacement device. All returned items must have a valid Zscaler RMA number. This number is crucial to ensure the accurate tracking and handling of returned items. For any questions related to RMA or shipping, contact your Zscaler support representative.
Do not return any Hardware until an RMA is issued.
The RMA process is complete after the replacement device is successfully installed and operational and Zscaler receives the defective device.

You acknowledge and agree that it is your responsibility to remove any and all data before shipping or disposing of your devices. Zscaler is not responsible for the security, safeguarding, or return of any data left on devices that have been shipped to or disposed of by Zscaler.
